settings.heading: We sell the moment, not the object
settings.body: NexaBrand BD started because buying a decent gift in Bangladesh was harder than it should be — either overpriced imports, or something that fell apart in a month. So we built the shop we wanted to buy from.

settings.text: Every supplier visited, not just emailed
Each piece opened and checked before it ships

settings.heading: Fewer products,
settings.body:
We would rather stock forty things we would give our own family than four hundred we have never held. Everything on this site has been handled, worn, or tested by someone on the team first.

When something stops meeting that bar, we drop it — even if it sells well.

settings.title: Authentic or nothing
settings.text: Direct from the brand or its authorised distributor. If we cannot verify it, we do not list it.

settings.title: Gift-ready by default
settings.text: The box, the ribbon and the card are not an upsell. They come with every order, free.

settings.title: A person, not a bot
settings.text: WhatsApp us between 10am and 9pm and a human replies — usually inside the hour.

settings.title: Easy to undo
settings.text: Wrong size, wrong colour, changed your mind — 7 days, and we collect it from you.

settings.heading: Four promises we do not bend

settings.text: Formulated for humidity, dust and long commutes

settings.heading: Our own line,
settings.body: We could not find skincare built for this climate, so we made it. NexaBeauty is developed with a Korean lab and blended for Bangladeshi weather — lightweight, non-greasy, and it holds up on a rickshaw at 2pm.

settings.quote: I have ordered from them four times now, for four different people. Not one complaint, and the packaging keeps getting better.
